The FDA has approved Lembaz (adrabetadex) to lower the risk of death in adults and children with a severe form of Niemann-Pick disease type C (NPC). The medicine is approved for patients who weigh at least 7 kilograms (about 15 pounds) and whose brain and nerve symptoms started before age 6. This early form of the illness is often called infantile-onset NPC.
